name: sha256
description: SHA-256 (hex) of the raw GCS object: the PDF bytes, or the exported email JSON. Natural key - one row per distinct document

name: doc_type
description: Document type the extractor settled on. Same as routed_doc_type, except a PDF whose text says CBP Form 7501 is customs_7501 wherever it was filed

name: routed_doc_type
description: Document type from the GCS path, i.e. what the Gmail export guessed from the search, filename and subject

name: source_kind
description: pdf_attachment or email_body

name: parser
description: What produced the record, e.g. pdftotext-layout, pdftotext-layout+documentai-form-parser, pdftotext-layout+customs_7501, email-body

name: parser_version
description: Image version (git short sha) of the extract service that wrote the record

name: parse_status
description: parsed (a typed parser read it - only customs_7501 today), unparsed (text extracted, no typed parser for this layout yet) or failed (no text, or the typed parser rejected it; see parse_error and quarantine/)

name: parse_error
description: Why parse_status is failed, or a non-fatal extraction note (e.g. Document AI refused the file)

name: page_count
description: Pages in the PDF (pdfinfo). Null for email bodies

name: full_text
description: pdftotext -layout output for PDFs (the text the 7501 parser reads); the plain-text body for emails

name: docai_text
description: Document AI Form Parser OCR text. Null when Document AI was not used (7501s, emails, processor not configured)

name: tables
description: Document AI tables: [{page, header_rows: [[cell...]], body_rows: [[cell...]]}]. The same tables are written as CSV next to the NDJSON

name: entities
description: Document AI form fields and entities: {form_fields: [{page, name, value, confidence}], entities: [{type, text, confidence}]}

name: typed
description: Typed parse. customs_7501 only: the parse_7501() result plus validate() findings from tools/customs_entries_load.py. Null otherwise

name: gcs_uri
description: gs:// URI of the raw object (provenance)

name: processed_uri
description: gs:// URI of the NDJSON this row was loaded from

name: source_file
description: Original attachment filename, or the Gmail message id for an email body

name: gmail_message_id
description: Gmail message id the document was exported from (first one seen, for a PDF sent more than once)

name: gmail_thread_id
description: Gmail thread id

name: email_date
description: Gmail internal date of the message

name: email_from
description: From header as received

name: email_subject
description: Subject header as received

name: search_query
description: The Gmail search that matched the thread

name: meta
description: The full .meta.json (PDFs) or export envelope (emails) written by the Apps Script

name: extracted_at
description: When the extract service wrote the NDJSON (UTC). A --full reload only overwrites a row with a newer extraction

name: ingested_at
description: When the row was loaded (UTC)

name: ingested_by
description: Account that ran the load (the freight-docs-load service account)
